select cast(d.order_detail_id as char) as lineKey, 0 as auditedQty, coalesce(sum(d.delivery_quantity), 0) as pendingQty, 0 as rejectedQty from scm_combined_delivery_detail d inner join scm_combined_delivery c on c.combined_id = d.combined_id where and and d.order_id = #{orderId} and d.delivery_detail_id is null and d.combined_id != #{excludeCombinedId} group by d.order_detail_id

select coalesce(sum(d.delivery_quantity), 0) from scm_combined_delivery_detail d inner join scm_combined_delivery c on c.combined_id = d.combined_id where and and d.order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} and d.delivery_detail_id is null and d.combined_id != #{excludeCombinedId}

select od.detail_id as order_detail_id, o.order_id as order_id, o.order_no as order_no, od.material_id as material_id, od.material_code as material_code, od.material_name as material_name, od.specification as specification, od.model as model, od.unit as unit, od.purchase_price as price, od.pack_coefficient as pack_coefficient, od.manufacturer_name as manufacturer, od.register_no as register_no, o.hospital_id as hospital_id, h.hospital_name as hospital_name, o.warehouse_name as warehouse, h.address as delivery_address, greatest( ifnull(od.order_quantity, 0) - ifnull(( select sum(dd.delivery_quantity) from scm_delivery_detail dd inner join scm_delivery del on del.delivery_id = dd.delivery_id where (dd.del_flag is null or dd.del_flag = '' or dd.del_flag = '0') and (del.del_flag is null or del.del_flag = '' or del.del_flag = '0') and dd.order_detail_id = od.detail_id ), 0) - ifnull(( select sum(cd.delivery_quantity) from scm_combined_delivery_detail cd inner join scm_combined_delivery cb on cb.combined_id = cd.combined_id where (cd.del_flag is null or cd.del_flag = '' or cd.del_flag = '0') and (cb.del_flag is null or cb.del_flag = '' or cb.del_flag = '0') and cd.order_detail_id = od.detail_id and cd.delivery_detail_id is null and cd.combined_id != #{combinedId} ), 0) , 0) as undelivered_qty from scm_order_detail od inner join scm_order o on o.order_id = od.order_id left join scm_hospital h on o.hospital_id = h.hospital_id where (o.del_flag is null or o.del_flag = '' or o.del_flag = '0') and (od.del_flag is null or od.del_flag = '' or od.del_flag = '0') and o.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and o.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} and o.warehouse_name = #{warehouse} and not exists ( select 1 from scm_delivery d where and d.combined_id is null and ( d.order_id = o.order_id or exists ( select 1 from scm_delivery_detail dd where dd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id and (dd.del_flag is null or dd.del_flag = '' or dd.del_flag = '0') and dd.order_detail_id in (select odx.detail_id from scm_order_detail odx where odx.order_id = o.order_id) ) ) ) having undelivered_qty > 0 order by o.order_id desc, od.detail_id
